# P04 opt-in directory usability companion

Follow-up to the [source-styled P04 evidence](2026-09-14-directory-typed-adapter.md).
This is an enhancement of the second typed candidate, not a third converted component
or a certified target. Counts remain 439/657 syntax/compiler/DOM, five saved syntax
attempts, two typed source-specific candidates and zero certified targets.

## Separate output, shared data

`assets-adapt-directory -enhanced` returns the unchanged base artifact nested under
`base`, plus a separately hashed template/model/CSS companion. Its CUE envelope and
replay verifier retain `not-verified`. Default invocation and `-enhanced=false` return
the original JSON shape and bytes. P02's adapter and private delivery are unchanged.

`NewDirectoryEnhanced(Directory)` delegates validation and snapshotting to the base
constructor, then wraps the exact rendered content in one `data-appkit-directory` div.
There are no new data fields or runtime dependencies. Scoped CSS preserves the purchased
palette/type and provides 44px minimum links, a 2px row-link focus outline and
complete-value wrapping with a bounded minimum role column. Load it after the source stylesheet; the original constructor
remains separately usable. See the [consumer guide](fixtures/table-adapter/README.md).

Empty and partial states use app-owned Introduction copy and row sets. Add stays a
native link to an app-owned route. There is no invented directory backend, account
authorization, loading service, sort/filter/page/export engine or token remapping.

## Compiler and replay evidence

Synthetic tests compile the base and companion before/after templ formatting. They
verify exact wrapper-only DOM, unchanged validation/errors, slice snapshots, escaped
state copy, cancellation/writer propagation and 0/3/6/100 rows. Scoped CSS contract
checks are source-level checks, not evidence of actual browser geometry.

The explicit paid probe verifies the frozen original archive/member and unchanged
catalog, deterministic adaptation, exact base equality and companion/base tamper
refusal. Four scenarios compile/render both variants before and after formatting:

| Scenario | App-owned data |
|---|---|
| baseline6 | Six source example records; explicit local Add/Edit routes |
| empty0 | No rows; truthful empty copy and Add route |
| partial3 | First three examples; explicitly partial result copy |
| long6 | Near-bound unbroken records, long heading/action/column labels, escaped introduction |

All 16 rendered fragments are retained privately, with two completion markers, source
and artifact files, scenario JSON and generated source. The manifest binds 37 payloads
and 10 selected source identities. These identities are not a full-worktree attestation.
Original artifact templates stay untouched; explicitly named formatted copies and both
phases' generated Go files are retained. Browser admission binds both original template
bytes to the artifact, not just their self-reported inventory hashes.
No licensed derivative is added to distributable source or the public vendor channel.

Actual paid CLI checks pass byte-equal default/explicit-false output, repeated enhanced
JSON, exact nested base equality and independent replay. Root Go tests/vet, scoped
race tests and the combined base/enhanced CUE schema check pass. The full MCP package
tests include document/resource parity; no host restart or adoption is implied.

## Browser evidence

The matrix covers four scenarios, 390/1440 CSS pixels, light/dark and JS on/off;
32 source-styled/enhanced screenshots accompany 112 native Add/Edit activations across
64 configurations. Every row action is checked by full accessible name and exact route.
The strict loopback fixture permits exactly 256 GETs, no application script, external
asset request, WebSocket or service worker. Fonts, text/focus contrast, geometry and
all input/code identities are checked independently of compiler success.

The initial wrapper oracle compared a component's children with a full body's contents.
HTML parsing places the document envelope's trailing LF in body, outside the component.
Its 16 false fidelity failures remain preserved. The corrected oracle wraps every
source component node without normalization, retains the one verified host-owned LF
outside the wrapper, and compares the complete bodies. A whitespace canary stays live.

Visual review then found ordinary mobile roles reduced to vertical letters, although
the first geometry checks reported no overflow. A new text-line check reproduced four
failures. Reserving role-column width fixes them; a bounded follow-up selected 5rem
over 6rem because it also keeps all six ordinary email examples on one line at 390px.
Near-bound hostile values still wrap completely and can make deliberately tall rows.
Source-styled target/focus failures and every intermediate receipt remain separate.
Final expanded matrix: **448/464 checks pass**, with exactly 16 separately retained
source-styled target-size failures and **zero boundary, fidelity or enhanced-quality
failures**. All 112 activations and the exact 256-request multiset pass. Minimum sampled
normal-text contrast is 4.576:1; observed focus outlines are at least 2px and 3.877:1.
All 24 ordinary-role/email readability checks and 16 whitespace canaries pass.
Main inspected the final mobile/dark default rows, plus earlier empty, partial and
long-content views. The deliberately hostile long fixture is not a polished real task.

Final receipt SHA-256:
`369136fa703a895b0d9f950bbde8c5b4ad796495e701e364c7ad1e6a9a0bad26`.
A separate child-process receipt records Node 26.3.0 exit 0, no signal and empty stderr;
the harness pins Playwright 1.63.0 and records Chrome 152.0.7977.84. An intermediate
passing-assertion report had an unexplained tool-reported exit 1; no successful process
claim is made for that run. Later explicit child-process receipts resolve the final run.

Private history lives in `data/design-assets/directory-enhanced.yZoXOf`, final snapshot
`final-kic0bc`: 371 payloads / 20,648,669 bytes including five browser receipts and
their harness/source snapshots. Copy identities and 0700/0600 modes were verified.
Store manifest: `c328379b49b641c17c5fffeef9a56dffb7085ad6c6d4a47e135f84a8bc5b34f3`.
Final artifact: `4c15cf24826d642c860db4bfe445b01588c3cbc08b532791a6d4cbb91255a1ef`.
This ignored evidence needs separate backup; it is not protected by Git. No originals
were overwritten, removed or silently repaired. No target certification is claimed.

## Remaining boundaries

Real accessibility/zoom/assistive input, mixed-script text, large-data performance,
actual app tasks, delivery and catalog promotion remain separate evidence gates.
P04 is still JSON-only. ADR-0034's shared-delivery review is open; preserve P02's exact
CLI/artifact/six-file contract when reusing only the proven private filesystem boundary.
No consumer pin, global configuration, deployment, push or tag changed in this slice.
